question: Proved long-run rates (minimum cycle mean) and boundedness of the least ray bond in the 664 one-definition limit-only families.

definitions.classes: record classes bounded/rising/flat/capped as in the spec

public_inputs.code: written by Codex in codex/ from the spec; BOND-DEPTH census.py and runs_merged.jsonl read-only.
public_inputs.run: codex exec with the spec, one memory-capped unit, from the repository root.

forbidden_inputs: Changing the spec, predictions or decision rules after seeing registered results
primary_observable: lambda per family on complete graphs; bounded_all; the gate.
validation_gate: L_ray(s) recomputed from the graph equals the records.

predictions.P2: lambda > 0 in >= 90% of rising with complete graphs
predictions.P3: bounded_all in >= 90% of flat with complete graphs

stop_rule: One Codex run, its outputs checked; a hand-off to the referee thread; report.
